summary: Booster 21 launched Flight 14, the first orbital Starship flight. It was the first Block 3 booster to complete its boostback and landing burns for a controlled splashdown in the Gulf of Mexico.

history.event: Cryogenic proof test 1 at Massey's (partial load)
Full-duration 33-engine static fire of about 15 seconds at OLP-2
Launched on Flight 14; controlled splashdown in the Gulf of Mexico
